messages.text: Hi Hal and Sarah — to be precise about what's wrong: on both miners the main fan is attached. It's the second fans that were never fitted — there was no hardware to connect them, and the only thing in the box was some fuses. I need the hardware to connect the second fans to the miner, and some direction on how they fit. I sent a photo of the fans on Oct 27. The miners are two BSB NerdQaxe++, order Shop····, delivered in (address hidden) July 17. I won't run either miner with a fan unattached. Thanks, Paul

Hi Paul,

Thanks for clearing that up, it helps a lot. The main fan is fitted on both miners, and the second fan on each one came loose. There was nothing in the box to mount or connect those second fans, only some fuses. Our earlier request only asked for "fan screws," so I've now corrected it to say what you actually need: the hardware to fit and connect the second fan on both units, and instructions for fitting them. Your Oct 27 photo of the fans is part of the request too.

The NerdQaxe++ is built to run two fans. Its firmware has separate Fan 1 and Fan 2 channels, so the loose fans are meant to go on these boards. I don't want to guess how this particular kit mounts its second fan, so I've sent the question to JD, our hardware lead. He'll confirm the exact parts and how they fit.

You're right not to run either miner with a fan unattached. Please keep them off until the second fans are mounted.

The team is offline today, so they'll pick this up tomorrow at 10am ET, and their answer will come to your email. If you want a quicker answer on fitting the fans, you can also ask in our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf and mention @nullhashrate. That's JD, and he's very active there.

Best regards,
Hal, HeliumDeploy technical support
